summary: Iteration 39 — verified mandatory-proof-upload rollout across AR receipts, booking-fee, cost-invoices, deposits & KPR disbursement plus all-in BOOKING-component redirect. Ran /app/tests/smoke_booking_allin.py (PASS end-to-end: booking fee closes 2-1470 BOOKING cost invoice; AR paid=0; deposit balance=0 with in+apply_cost entries). Authored pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter39_proof_and_booking.py (10 passed, 2 skipped for missing dataset preconditions cost invoice & overridable legal gate; both endpoints still exercised via non-existent-id path to confirm validator triggers before existence check). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: (1) /finance Piutang → 'Terima Bayar' dialog exposes ar-receipt-proof-input, ar-receipt-proof-input-required-empty red warning and ar-receipt-submit disabled while empty; enables after set_input_files. (2) /finance Titipan tab → 'Terima Titipan' dialog exposes deposit-proof-input, deposit-proof-input-required-empty warning and deposit-receive-submit disabled. (3) Legal timeline present (contract-legal-step x6) on a Draft contract; no override buttons enabled — noted per playbook. (4) Lead detail Unit & SPR tab → Booking fee panel booking-fee-pay-button opens dialog with bf-pay-proof-input, bf-pay-proof-input-required-empty warning and booking-fee-pay-submit disabled while empty. All matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptCreate.proof_file_ids min_length=1 + FileList validator correctly returns 400/422 with Indonesian message; validator triggers before route lookup which lets us regression-test without a real invoice/deal.

allin_engine.compute_amount for BOOKING code short-circuits to booking_fee input; apply_booking_deposit routes booking-fee receipt to 2-1470 (cost_invoice type=booking_deposit) — verified by smoke + manual mongo trace.
EvidenceUploader shows required-empty warning + disables submit purely via prop-driven state; consistent testid pattern <scope>-proof-input(-required-empty) enables reliable e2e.
